methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: An established EnPI methodology developed by Grabowki et al. helps to interprete measured variables in their respective role as effort, beneﬁt or inﬂuencing factors of the process

paper_type.evidence_quote: The presented concept couples this optimization procedure with the plant model in AML. In every run of the optimization routine, a parser reads the AML ﬁle and new data is fetched from the linked database.

level_3b.evidence_quote: The procedure is demonstrated using the example of an industrial cooling system.

stage1.notes: The applied context is an industrial cooling/refrigeration system, but no host industry from the closed Level 3B sector list is identified.

multi_site.evidence_quote: A case-study on real and simulated data of a refrigeration plant veriﬁed the proposed AML/EnEffIPK concept.
